from pydantic import BaseModel, Field

class JudgmentDocument(BaseModel):
    """A single judgment document record extracted for classification."""
    document_title: str | None = Field(description="The identifier or title of the judgment document (e.g., 'Document 1', '《判决文书 4》')")
    case_nature: str | None = Field(description="The broad legal nature of the proceeding: 'Criminal', 'Civil', or 'Administrative'")
    primary_charge_or_cause: str | None = Field(description="The specific criminal charge or civil cause of action identified (e.g., '交通肇事罪', '保险合同纠纷')")
    key_subjects: list[str] | None = Field(description="Key parties or entities involved that help distinguish the legal relationship")

class Parse(BaseModel):
    documents: list[JudgmentDocument]
